task.title: How to Install the NC State VPN Client
task.shortdesc: Learn how to download and install the Cisco Secure Client on a Windows 10 or 11 computer to access NC State's virtual private network (VPN).

taskbody.context:
NC State provides a virtual private network (VPN) connection through the Cisco Secure Client software. A VPN connection is typically required when accessing sensitive information or using on-campus resources from an off-campus connection.
The following instructions explain how to install the Cisco Secure Client on Windows 10 or 11.
If you're using macOS, Linux, or a mobile device, please refer to NC State's installation instructions for your operating system.

step.cmd: Download the Cisco Secure Client installer.
Double click on the downloaded file to begin the installation.
Accept the End User License Agreement.
If you are prompted, allow the application to make changes on your computer.

taskbody.result: The Cisco Secure Client will be added to your Start menu.
taskbody.postreq: After installing the Cisco Secure Client, you can follow the instructions on How to Connect to the NC State VPN.
